scope: CertivoIQ production application at certivoiq.com and Supabase project emnkzxkcpnyvglwxraxm

controls.evidence: Published privacy notice and inspected submission workflows
controls.statement: CertivoIQ receives account, organization, portfolio, certification, evidence, support, and billing-related information only through disclosed product workflows.
Public production traffic is served over HTTPS with HTTP Strict Transport Security enabled.
Every public production table has Row Level Security enabled; all production Storage buckets are private and policy-controlled.

controls.evidence: Production Auth and account-security workflow inspection
controls.statement: CertivoIQ supports authenticated sessions, TOTP enrollment, recovery codes, and server-authorized role checks. MFA is available but is not represented as universally enforced.

controls.evidence: Production schema and append-only event-control audit
controls.statement: Compliance review, source verification, PHA, staff-access, operations, and retention workflows record attributable events and timestamps where implemented.

controls.evidence: Deployed operations-worker v1 and retention_purge_events control
controls.statement: Customer certification-import and correction-evidence objects are scheduled for deletion 14 days after paid access ends. The supervised worker records completion or failure and fails closed on deletion errors.

controls.evidence: Production project and hosting configuration inspection
controls.statement: The application is hosted through Lovable; the primary production database, authentication, and storage services use Supabase in Canada Central. Billing workflows use Stripe where configured.
Suspected vulnerabilities can be reported through the CertivoIQ support channel identified in security.txt.
DPA and security-questionnaire requests are accepted through CertivoIQ support and require contract-specific review.
